Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

passport — a document you need to travel abroad. Example: Here is my passport.
bag — a container you carry things in. Example: My bag is small.
hotel — a building where travellers sleep. Example: I check in at the hotel.
airport — a place where planes take off. Example: The airport is far from the city.
ticket — a paper that lets you travel. Example: I buy a ticket to London.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I would like to check in.
• Here is my passport.
• Can I take this bag?
• I have got one bag.
• A quiet room, please.
